Websites she likes:

* [https://www.homeinstead.com/](https://www.homeinstead.com/)  
  * Likes the content on this site  
  * Structure  
  * Apply to be a caregiver option, but put at the bottom  
  * Google reviews widget \- remove last names  
* [https://www.amadaseniorcare.com/north-shore-senior-care/](https://www.amadaseniorcare.com/north-shore-senior-care/)  
* [https://www.fathershearthomecare.com/](https://www.fathershearthomecare.com/)  
  * Likes moving, silent video in header \- highlights what they do  
  * Overall likes the first impression on this site  
  * Call out of how we can help you  
* Drop down of services \- not sure which competitor website, but would want to enhance what they currently have  
* Contact form  
  * Would need to be careful with HIPAA / insurance  
  * Clear explanation of what the process is  
      
* Current website \- what she likes  
  * Like the polished look \- but want to tone down the colors. Softer, pastel colors  
  * Integrity, Support, & Community messaging  
  * Want to diversify the people in the imagery  
    * More older, caucasian males \- primary customers  
  * Improve accessibility  
      
* If website build goes through, likely would want to do migrate hosting & maintenance

Tamra and Don are business partners. They both value a local partnership

* Want to center the client (people who are looking to get care) instead of the caregiver  
* Competitors are very detailed, focused on customer, solutions they are providing customer  
* Want to be caregiver focused  
  * Caring for parent \- can get paid for that  
  * Pivot to private pay  
* Current website doesn’t match what they actually do  
  * Website reads as if Aalair will be providing a caregiver  
  * Initially focused on medicare/medicaid clients. Shifting more to private clients  
  * Pivoting to home instead model  
    * Targeting short and long term disability   
    * Helping them find solutions  
  * Concierge home care agency  
    * Providing them with a high quality of life  
    * Partnership with peace of mind  
  * Want to find a way to convey what they do and what sets them apart  
  * Process \- private clients  
    * People to go website and fill out contact form  
    * Do an assessment, meet client and family, determine what their needs are  
  * Want contact to go directly to email  
    * Contact form or assessment to have more details (when do you need services to start, etc)  
  * Want sales process to be easier  
  * Referrals from other providers

Quick summary and background on this prospect, Tamra Nalls with Aalair Home Care 

* Prospect came through as a lead from the website, mentioning general interest in marketing and brand awareness  
* Pat and I had a virtual meeting with her, initially chatting on programmatic and website enhancements  
* Conversation pivoted to a bigger website project / possible full website build. Prospect had sent over example websites that she likes and would want to mimic.  
* I verified with Bob that we can do website work on this site
